# demo-app

A demonstration repository. Everything here exists to show how the espalier
renders.

## Structure

    ./
    ├─ components/
    │  └─ buttons/
    ├─ src/
    │  │
    │  └─ clients/  outbound API integrations
    │
    └─ main.ts      the application entry point (required)

Nothing else may exist under this directory.

## main.ts — the application entry point

Wire up the application and start it. No business logic here.
